class.name: RenderingNativeSurface
class.brief_description: Reference-counted wrapper for a host-provided rendering surface.
class.description: Used by LibGodot to render into a surface supplied by an embedding application. Assign a platform-specific surface with [method Window.set_native_surface]. Keep native resources valid until [method DisplayServerEmbedded.detach_native_surface] completes. Release host references to engine objects before destroying the Godot instance.
